FN-GLJH622-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 432
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Representative Hassell
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 04/15/2024
REVISED
House Bill 432 as introduced would increase the obligations of the State Comptroller's Office
by an undetermined amount dependent on the cost of any additional staff hired to process state
employee payroll deductions for consumer goods and financial instruments.

House Bill 432
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Representative Hassell
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 04/16/2024
House Bill 432 as reported by the Committee on State Government would increase the
obligations of the State Comptroller's Office by an undetermined amount dependent on the cost
of any additional staff hired to process state employee payroll deductions for financial
instruments offered through membership associations.
